name: Anna
source:
She is Wakin's only daughter and a lovely young lady, but when she is kidnapped by a demon and put into danger, it is Anduke who saves her.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071215205316fw_/http://www.mink.co.jp/lineup/da/char16.html]Mink[/url]]
